title: Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano Pod Kit
description:
The
Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano Pod Kit
is a compact square-shaped pod system featuring a 1.09-inch colour touchscreen with 29 customizable themes, the largest battery in the XROS 5 range at 1600mAh, and COREX 3.0 heating technology.
Product Type:
Open Pod System (Refillable)
Battery:
1600mAh
Wattage:
Up to 30W (3 Power Modes: Eco, Normal, Power)
Charging:
USB Type-C (2A Fast Charge)
E-Liquid Capacity:
3mL
Coil Type:
Integrated COREX 3.0 Mesh
Coil Resistance:
0.6Ω + 0.8Ω (included)
Activation:
Draw-Activated
Airflow:
Adjustable Slider (MTL to RDL)
Display:
1.09" Colour Touchscreen (29 Themes)
Fill Method:
Top Fill
Pod Compatibility:
All Vaporesso XROS Pods (0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.0Ω, 1.2Ω - COREX 3.0 and 2.0)
Brand:
Vaporesso
E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.
Available options: Black Satin, Damascus Silver.

The Vaporesso XROS 5 Nano Pod Kit is a compact square-shaped pod system featuring a 1.09-inch colour touchscreen with 29 customizable themes, the largest battery in the XROS 5 range at 1600mAh, and COREX 3.0 heating technology.

  • Product Type: Open Pod System (Refillable)
  • Battery: 1600mAh
  • Wattage: Up to 30W (3 Power Modes: Eco, Normal, Power)
  • Charging: USB Type-C (2A Fast Charge)
  • E-Liquid Capacity: 3mL
  • Coil Type: Integrated COREX 3.0 Mesh
  • Coil Resistance: 0.6Ω + 0.8Ω (included)
  • Activation: Draw-Activated
  • Airflow: Adjustable Slider (MTL to RDL)
  • Display: 1.09" Colour Touchscreen (29 Themes)
  • Fill Method: Top Fill
  • Pod Compatibility: All Vaporesso XROS Pods (0.4Ω, 0.6Ω, 0.8Ω, 1.0Ω, 1.2Ω - COREX 3.0 and 2.0)
  • Brand: Vaporesso

E-liquid sold separately. Fill with your choice of salt nic or freebase e-liquid.

Available options: Black Satin, Damascus Silver.
